description: Fetch a subreddit's posting rules by name (Reddit's /r/<name>/about/rules data). Returns a `rules` list, each with name, description, what it applies to (posts, comments, or all), violation reason, priority, and creation date, plus a `site_rules` list of Reddit's site-wide rules. Use it to check a community's rules before posting or commenting. Example: name='python'.

name.description: Subreddit name WITHOUT the r/ prefix (e.g. 'python'). Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_subreddit_rules
